tspan.tspan: A couple of well timed recoveries
can get you right back into things.
Well, this card stops all that and
lets you focus on finishing things
off.
Guns, guns, guns. How’s about
you get another one, for free?
Having a free shot at an enemy
character has got to be a good
thing. Just roll the dice and hope
for the best!

text.inkscape:label: And Justice for All

tspan.tspan: And Justice for All

text.tspan: At the end of the turn, the player may choose a character. That character takes a Nerve test. If passed, the character removes a single

text.inkscape:label: I am the Law

tspan.tspan: I am the Law

text.tspan: Any Lawman character in line of sight of the Sheriff, even if obscured by other models, receives a +1 bonus to their Nerve tests. This is
in addition to the modifier for having friendly characters within 15cm (see Corebook page 14).
At least half of the faction must be armed with a pistol as their sole ranged weapon. A maximum of two members may have a shotgun.
If mounted Characters are permitted in the Scene then one mounted Character may be equipped with a lasso. “I Am The Law’’ is used
all of the time. “And Justice For All” may be used once per turn at the end of a turn.
